items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: And I remember Preach used to sit on our porch at the steps

ctx.x: But a tiple has five strings.

Right. So then he showed him how to get to the other string from that, and still had the four. And I remember Preach used to sit on our porch at the steps, and he'd strike at some things, at playing. He didn't know that many changes, all he could do was solo work, but it felt good when he played. It felt like a happy sound, especially when he sang along with it, you see. There's no question about he was just the type of person that picked this up. Just picked it up and started playing, you know. He wasn't...no…
And Wes got hooked from that?
